name: qkd_ahub_sdb-b1-COMMIT
purpose: KV-ATTN4 10-20 (COORD 09:56 decision (b), tree K.STA.AHUB, AHUB_OFS_BOUND): the CLOSED a7 hub (qkd_ahub_sdw-a7-c6c412b4c, TT +8.48 / FF +8.83) with AP_OFS / FR_OFS BOOT-PROGRAMMABLE (qkd_ahub_static_dw_bo): static N-face inputs ofs_ap[31:0] (4 x 8-bit two's complement) + ofs_fr[7:0] land in u_io pin flops and replace the elaborated constants in the same adders (0 cycles, same pins otherwise, same outline/children/floorplan). The boot image / kv_static_params table supplies the die's values (today AP [-40,-40,-38,-39] / FR -7 vs hardened a7 [-36,-36,-34,-35] / -7), so the hub is built once. Bench = a7 s4o bench with the offsets on the boot pins (m0 PASS; m8/m9/m10 = wrong boot values FAIL; m1..m7, m11, m12 as a7).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qkd_ahub_static_dw_bo #(.Z_IN_STRIDE(4)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/qkd_ahub_static_dw_bo.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qkd_ahub_static_cal_gen.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qkd_ahub_core.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_pipe.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_nhb_tiles_bb.v rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qkh_recip_leaf_bb.v && echo lint-ok

bench.name: ahub_dw_s4o_m0
bench.pass_regex: ^AHUB_DW PASS mut=0 passes=7 Z_IN_STRIDE=4 zwords=680 .* FR_OFS=-7 AP_OFS=ffddffdeffdcffdc
